summary: @or-sdk/contacts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against a shipped ~727KB file `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with `_0x...` identifier and string-indirection tricks. `math_init.js` is a single-line Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with hex-identifier variables, a shuffled string/number array, and an array-rotation decoder characteristic of obfuscator.io output; it is not reachable from the package's `main` and only executes because the preinstall step fetches an alternate runtime to run it. The pattern — pulling a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated in-tree bundle — is the alternate-runtime dropper shape, and it runs on every installer's host with the installer's privileges on `npm install`. The obfuscation of both the loader and the payload has no purpose consistent with a normal SDK build.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
